annotation.title_clean: Proposal for a Regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council amending Regulations (EU) 2021/694, (EU) 2021/695, (EU) 2021/697, (EU) 2021/1153, (EU) 2023/1525 and 2024/795, as regards incentivising defence-related investments in the EU budget to implement the ReArm Europe Plan
annotation.title_en: Proposal for a Regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council amending Regulations (EU) 2021/694, (EU) 2021/695, (EU) 2021/697, (EU) 2021/1153, (EU) 2023/1525 and 2024/795, as regards incentivising defence-related investments in the EU budget to implement the ReArm Europe Plan
named_instruments_referenced: Joint White Paper European Defence Readiness 2030
annotation.summary_en: European Commission legislative proposal (COM(2025) 188) amending STEP, Horizon Europe, EDF, Digital Europe, CEF and ASAP regulations to channel EU budget funds into defence and dual-use technologies under the ReArm Europe Plan, adding defence (including drones, anti-drone systems and AI) as a fourth STEP strategic sector and funding AI Gigafactories.
key_provisions_or_claims: Adds 'defence technologies' (incl. drones, anti-drone systems, AI, electronic warfare) as fourth STEP strategic sector
Opens EIC Accelerator to dual-use and defence-focused innovation as exception to Horizon Europe civil-only rule
Digital Europe Programme to support dual-use projects and deploy AI Factories and Gigafactories, with eligibility restrictions for third-country-controlled entities
EDF allows cumulative funding, cohesion fund transfers and simplified support for disruptive defence technologies
Extends ASAP to 31 Dec 2026 and allows CEF military mobility co-financing up to 100%
